text: page is the per-page record of one book and holds page_size = 64 tokens. The PR adds the two K layout bit arrays and their accessors to it.

fields.name: page
fields.type_or_shape: struct alignas(64) page final; inline static const size_t page_size = 64
fields.one_line: The public interface to the KV cache store is the (public methods of the) book and page structs (Note [KV Cache Store], kv_cache.hpp:50-54).

text: kv_block::k is now of type k_storage: the typed owner k_vnni_tensor<page_size, head_size> for a VNNI slot, the bf16 array native_k_storage otherwise. Both hold page_size * head_size bf16 values, pinned by a static_assert on sizeof.

fields.name: k
fields.one_line: Native K: one row of head_size bf16 values per token, indexed [p * head_size + i]. Packed K (TRON_K_VNNI, 128-dimension heads): k is the typed owner k_vnni_tensor of Note [K VNNI storage] (kv_cache.hpp:2986-2990).

text: native_k_storage is the row-major K array, bf16[page_size * head_size]. std::conditional_t only names the unselected type, so a row-major geometry never instantiates the owner.

fields.name: native_k_storage
fields.one_line: std::conditional_t only names the unselected type, so a row-major geometry never instantiates the owner (kv_cache.hpp:2990-2991).

text: k_vnni_tensor<Rows, Cols> owns one packed K plane: exactly one 64-byte-aligned bf16 array of Rows * Cols elements, trivial to construct, copy and destroy. It exists only for Rows == 64 and Cols == 128, and copying an owner copies the plane.

fields.name: k_vnni_tensor
fields.type_or_shape: struct alignas(64) k_vnni_tensor final { alignas(64) bf16 data_[Rows * Cols]; } = 16 KiB for 64 x 128 (tensor_k_vnni.hpp:210, 230, 232-236)
fields.one_line: Owns one packed K plane: exactly one 64-byte-aligned bf16 array, no separate allocation and no initialization; copying an owner copies the plane (tensor_k_vnni.hpp:201-205).

text: k_vnni_view<T, Rows, Cols> is the only route to a packed plane: it comes from k_vnni_tensor::as_view(), reads one element with at(token, dim), and has no element write, no data(), no operator[] and no pointer conversion. T = bf16 is writable, T = const bf16 is read-only.

fields.name: k_vnni_view
fields.type_or_shape: struct k_vnni_view<T, Rows, Cols> final { T* data_; }; page::k_packed returns k_vnni_view<const bf16, page_size, geometry.head_size> (kv_cache.hpp:2120)
fields.one_line: A packed K plane of [Rows tokens * Cols dimensions]. Views come only from an owner (k_vnni_tensor::as_view). A writable view (bf16) converts to a read-only one (const bf16), never the reverse (tensor_k_vnni.hpp:156-162).

text: kv_block::v is the packed V plane, the typed owner v_vnni_tensor<page_size, head_size>, which the PR leaves unchanged. static_assert(sizeof(k) == sizeof(v)) ties the two planes to the same byte count.

fields.name: v
fields.type_or_shape: using v_storage = v_vnni_tensor<page_size, head_size>; alignas(kv_block_alignment) v_storage v
fields.one_line: v is the packed plane (the typed owner v_vnni_tensor): element (p, i) sits at bf16 index (p/2) * 2 * head_size + 2 * i + p%2 (kv_cache.hpp:3003-3004).

text: k_rows_saved_ records, per storage slot, which K rows of the page are saved: one bit per page offset in a 64-bit atomic. Entry layout_t::n_slots is the EAGLE storage.

fields.name: k_rows_saved_
fields.one_line: K rows saved, one bit per page offset, per storage slot (entry layout_t::n_slots = the EAGLE storage), VNNI slots only. Bits are set by save_k and by the full-block save, dropped by clear_kv_complete_at, carried by page copies (kv_cache.hpp:2608-2615).

text: k_vnni_blocks_ records, per storage slot, which 16-token blocks of the page hold the VNNI layout: one bit per block in an 8-bit atomic. A set bit implies the block's 16 row bits in k_rows_saved_.

fields.name: k_vnni_blocks_
fields.one_line: Converted 16-token blocks, one bit per block, per storage slot (the same entries). Set by the forward-end conversion and the full-block save, dropped by clear_kv_complete_at; a set bit implies the block's 16 row bits (kv_cache.hpp:2618-2620).

text: kv_saves_ is the pre-existing per-token per-slot save counter, indexed [offset][slot] by logical slot, with values 0, 1, 2 for neither, one, both of K and V saved. The two new bit arrays sit next to it, and the move constructor copies all three the same way.

fields.name: kv_saves_
fields.one_line: Per-token per-slot save counter. Indexed [offset][slot]. 0 = neither K nor V saved, 1 = one saved, 2 = both saved (kv_cache.hpp:2603-2604).

text: EAGLE_STORAGE_SLOTS_1 = 1 is the one state entry beyond the logical slots, for the EAGLE storage. It sizes both bit arrays.

fields.name: EAGLE_STORAGE_SLOTS_1
fields.one_line: One state entry beyond the logical slots: the EAGLE storage (kv_cache.hpp:2491).

text: Three named bool constants are the return values of note_k_row_saved (BLOCK_COMPLETED_FALSE: the row did not complete its block) and k_block_to_vnni_at (CONVERTED_FALSE, CONVERTED_TRUE: whether the block was converted).

fields.name: BLOCK_COMPLETED_FALSE, CONVERTED_FALSE, CONVERTED_TRUE
fields.one_line: note_k_row_saved: the row did not complete its block. k_block_to_vnni_at: whether the block was converted (kv_cache.hpp:2493-2495).

text: k_storage_ref pairs one physical storage slot (kv_storage_offset offset) with the index of its K layout state entry (size_t state_ix). The block conversion and the page copy take the pair as one argument, and the deferred conversion list of save_k keeps the resolved pair so a view change cannot redirect the conversion.

fields.name: k_storage_ref
fields.type_or_shape: struct k_storage_ref { kv_storage_offset offset; size_t state_ix; } (kv_cache.hpp:2145-2148)
fields.one_line: A storage slot and the index of its K layout state (Note [K VNNI storage]): the EAGLE entry for the EAGLE storage, the slot's own entry otherwise (kv_cache.hpp:2137-2139).

text: kv_storage_offset identifies an absolute K/V slot offset in a book's physical allocation. It is not a logical slot: EAGLE's extra physical slot has an offset but no logical descriptor.

fields.name: kv_storage_offset
fields.one_line: Identifies an absolute K/V slot offset in a book's physical allocation. This is used only to select an active cache view; it is not an operation or a logical slot within that view (common.hpp:239-241).

text: kv_slot_id is the dense zero-based logical slot index, valid in [0, logical_slot_count()). EAGLE selects a secondary physical allocation with kv_storage_offset without changing the logical slot ID.

fields.name: kv_slot_id
fields.one_line: Dense zero-based index into the model cache's kv_slot_specs, valid in [0, logical_slot_count()) (attention_ids.hpp:20-21).

text: kv_geometry carries the two numbers every K accessor is templated on: n_kv_heads and head_size. k_vnni::layout_on<geometry.head_size> is the VNNI gate.

fields.name: kv_geometry
fields.type_or_shape: struct kv_geometry { size_t n_kv_heads; size_t head_size; }
fields.one_line: Cache layout consumes geometry as data. Attention kernels separately carry the same dimensions as template arguments so their inner loops stay static (kv_cache.hpp:104-105).

text: book::storage_view_offset_ is the selected storage view (0 = primary, eagle_storage_offset() = EAGLE view). The PR adds book::eagle_view_active(), which is storage_view_offset_.i != 0: logical slot zero then addresses the extra physical slot.

fields.name: eagle_view_active / storage_view_offset_
fields.type_or_shape: bool eagle_view_active() const noexcept (new); kv_storage_offset storage_view_offset_{0} (kv_cache.hpp:1506, unchanged)
fields.one_line: Whether the EAGLE storage view is selected (set_storage_view). Logical slot zero then addresses the extra physical slot (kv_cache.hpp:1082-1083).

text: k_storage_readable reads two pre-existing book members: reclaimable_kv_restore_attempt_ == 0 (no private KV restore in flight) and slot_base(storage_offset) != nullptr (the slot's arena is allocated). k_forget_row converts bytes back to row-major only when both hold.

fields.name: k_storage_readable
fields.one_line: Whether the bytes of the storage slot may be read and written now: the book's storage is published (no private KV restore in flight) and the slot's arena is allocated (kv_cache.hpp:2534-2536).

text: pending_k_block in model.hpp is one queued conversion: a page pointer, the resolved page::k_storage_ref, and the block index. pending_k_blocks_ is the std::vector of them that convert_pending_k_blocks drains at the forward end.
